findings.message: File paths for pr_url_in and gate_result_in are extracted verbatim from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS via jq and then opened with no boundary check (no prefix validation against ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR or any expected root), so a maliciously crafted stage-inputs JSON could direct the plugin to read an arbitrary file path (e.g. /etc/passwd would pass the -f guard and be piped through tr).

The _ZBUILD_DEPLOY_RELEASE_LOADED guard variable is not a ZBUILD_* engine-dispatched variable, so it can be preset in the calling environment; when it is set, the source step is skipped and deploy_release_run is called unconditionally — if an attacker-controlled definition of deploy_release_run is already in scope (e.g. via environment function export on Linux with bash < 4.4 mitigations), it would run instead of the real plugin; safe failure only if the function is absent.
